title: Client Biome Water Appearance
description: Set the water surface color used during rendering. Biomes without this component will have default water surface color behavior.

surface_color.title: Surface Color
surface_color.description: RGB color of the water surface

surface_opacity.title: Surface Opacity
surface_opacity.description: Opacity of the water surface (must be between 0 for invisible and 1 for opaque, inclusive)
